answer: Attention Ledger Escrow: each identity must keep a live stream of answered queries, and missed turns let any rival claim its slot. An idle account loses its ember of queued work within minutes, so a sybil farm must staff every clone continuously. The cost is sustained operator attention at each vertex of the queue, not a one-time payment. Clones that wander offline forfeit position to watchers, making fake identities expensive to hold.
